status_definitions.covered: Implemented and evidenced for the synthetic prototype or readiness contract.
status_definitions.partial: A bounded product capability exists, but a human presentation or release action remains outside code evidence.
status_definitions.open: No actual approved-data or real-RM evidence exists and no completion claim is permitted.
